items.quote: And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom, even every one whose heart stirred him up to come unto the work to do it
items.claim: Moses called Bezaleel, Aholiab, and wise-hearted men to do the work

items.quote: in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom
items.claim: The LORD put wisdom in the hearts of the wise-hearted men

items.quote: And they received of Moses all the offering, which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, to make it withal
items.claim: The wise-hearted men received offerings from the children of Israel for the sanctuary

items.quote: And they brought yet unto him free offerings every morning
items.claim: Free offerings were brought every morning
